interaction_time_agent_guidance:
[SoT]
Before add: search/read existing tree. Repeat=no-op (or modify_reference). Supersede=remove stale + add new in same change-set. New topic=add. Never leave conflicting nodes side-by-side.
Capture: every definitive user reply (explicit OR pick from your A/B/C) -> add op ref'ing raw_input_id (pre_text carries the question). Prefer isolated yes/no or A/B/C questions; brief answers cite cleanly. Never paraphrase into user's mouth.
Op rules:
  parent_id required: '0'=top-level only if no fitting parent. Prefer adding under groups.
  <short_neutral_title>: 1-5 word noun phrase TOPIC, 1-50 chars. NOT a sentence/rule.
    good: "vendor placement", "phrase character voice"
    bad:  "Phrases must be in-character" (sentence), "vendor every other floor" (spec detail)
    Reviewer auto-amends overreaches via amended_short_title; persisted title shows in
    submit response's assigned_node_ids.
  char_range: forbidden if submission<=500 chars; allowed-but-optional if >500.
Batch related ops in ONE submit-change-set call.
On result: RELAY message_for_raw_input_sender VERBATIM to user, then proceed (approve) or adjust+resubmit / ask clarifying Q (reject).
top_level_injection_blurb_template:
[SoT] tree (id title; indented; --show-all for raw quotes):
{tree_compact_text}
Shortcuts (combo first to encourage tree organization):
  source-of-truth submit-change-set --add <raw_input_id> --parent <pid_or_letter> --title "<leaf>" --new-group "<group title>"
  source-of-truth submit-change-set --add <raw_input_id> --parent <pid_or_letter> --title "<leaf title>"
  source-of-truth submit-change-set --add-group --parent <pid_or_letter> --title "<group title>"
Read: `source-of-truth read <id> [<id> ...]`  Search: `source-of-truth search-nodes <q>`
Capture rule: on every definitive user reply (explicit OR pick from your A/B/C), queue an add op referencing the raw_input_id (just logged) under an appropriate parent (or '0' if none); char_range is FORBIDDEN when submission <=500 chars (cite whole entry) and ALLOWED-BUT-OPTIONAL when submission >500 chars; batch ops; never paraphrase.
See SKILL.md in the source-of-truth-agent-tool skill folder for full verb reference.
